name: Being an alpha male
example: We're not wolves, we're human beings. Being an alpha male is not about dominating other people but about dominating resistance within you

name: Balance in life and body
example: Balance between the parts of life is really critical, and it matters in your body specifically too

name: Community and accountability
example: Though he always knew porn wasn't good for him, the pleasure outweighed the risk. In his late 20s, a four-man Bible study and accountability group did NoFap and no-porn runs together. Once, about two months in, he found that getting close without releasing helped him keep going, without knowing the word "edging". Every time a group fell apart, so did his streak: without accountability, the old habits came back

name: Comparing yourself to others

name: Religion and faith
example: Raised in a very conservative Christian home, and still Christian, which really set him up for failure around sexuality. He was taught sex is only good inside marriage, so anything felt outside it is bad: "a war inside your head", with fear of hell. As a boy it was "don't touch yourself, don't do this", and parents are scared to talk about it. His dad's talk: you'll see people, get hard, something will come out

name: Setbacks and slips
example: A relapse. After a podcast episode on shame and a call where one of the guys shared his own shame, a lifetime of being told edging was shameful, that he was weird and different, and that "straight guys shouldn't be doing that" flooded back. He ran: cancelled his membership and deleted everything off his Instagram

name: Shame
example: Bring sexuality out of the shadows: it doesn't need to be taboo, secret or degenerate
